name: scope
description: Reads clinical trial monitoring notes and returns an evidence-backed risk call, findings, action items and a follow-up letter. Free to try, fictional data only.

paragraphs: SCOPE reads free-text clinical trial monitoring visit notes (formal visit reports, quick field notes, visit e-mails) and turns each one into a record anyone working on the study can act on:
Live app: scope-fabcank6.streamlit.app · try a demo study in two clicks, or rate a practice visit in Help SCOPE learn.
All notes, sites, studies and people in this repository and the app are fictional. Only use fictional or de-identified notes.
features: Risk level (high / medium / low) computed in code by a severity rubric, with the reason ("1 critical finding")
Every finding with its evidence: what is an active problem, what was fixed during the visit, and what was checked and fine, each with the sentence from the note that shows it

Judged by the study's own protocol: upload a protocol once and SCOPE drafts the study's rules (SAE definitions, reporting deadlines, visit windows, important deviations), each quoted with its page; deadlines are counted…
Site history across visits: each visit is added to its site, so the next visit opens with what is still open, and a problem that was active last time is pointed out
Learns from the people who use it: corrections and ratings that three users agree on change how SCOPE reads similar notes, for everyone, without a new release
